page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top, a verse block, a FINIS line, a woodcut ornament below, and a catchword-style signature at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: fimus Erasmus quando dixit: Bonos monachos Ecclesiæ esse ornamenta, Malos carcinomata : conquestus interim perquàm paucos esse ætate nostra, qui veri esse Monachi, aut boni videri queant. Nobis denique, qui nostris affectibus locum damus, & humanis consiliis omnia gerimus, nec ad divina respicimus, quo & certis & indubitatis, & æternis nitamur & hæreamus, vsu venit, quod omnibus regnis suo robore nixis accidit, quod à gentili Poeta (ceu Prophetam dicere malumus) dictum est:
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament with a face at the centre lies below FINIS and has no text. The catchword "BAR-" is at the lower right. The signature "KK 2" is at the lower left of the catchword line. Some words in the first paragraph are set with long s printed as s; the spelling is kept as printed.
